mistakes.text: Despite of the fan on full, the clipped pile didn't move at all.
mistakes.normalized: despite of the fan on full the clipped pile didn't move at all
mistakes.feedback_sk: „Despite“ sa používa bez „of“: „despite the fan“. S „of“ je len „in spite of“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: „Despite“ se používá bez „of“: „despite the fan“. S „of“ je jen „in spite of“.
mistakes.feedback_en: “Despite” takes no “of”: “despite the fan”. Only “in spite of” has “of”.

mistakes.text: Although the fan on full, the clipped pile didn't move at all.
mistakes.normalized: although the fan on full the clipped pile didn't move at all
mistakes.feedback_sk: Po „although“ musí nasledovať veta so slovesom; pred podstatným menom patrí „despite“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Po „although“ musí následovat věta se slovesem; před podstatným jménem patří „despite“.
mistakes.feedback_en: “Although” needs a full clause with a verb; before a noun phrase use “despite”.

mistakes.text: Even though the fan on full, the clipped pile didn't move at all.
mistakes.normalized: even though the fan on full the clipped pile didn't move at all
mistakes.feedback_sk: Po „although“ musí nasledovať veta so slovesom; pred podstatným menom patrí „despite“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Po „although“ musí následovat věta se slovesem; před podstatným jménem patří „despite“.
mistakes.feedback_en: “Although” needs a full clause with a verb; before a noun phrase use “despite”.

mistakes.text: Despite the fan was on full, the clipped pile didn't move at all.
mistakes.normalized: despite the fan was on full the clipped pile didn't move at all
mistakes.feedback_sk: Po „despite“ nemôže nasledovať veta so slovesom „was“; správne je „despite the fan on full“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Po „despite“ nemůže následovat věta se slovesem „was“; správně je „despite the fan on full“.
mistakes.feedback_en: “Despite” can't be followed by a clause with “was”; say “despite the fan on full”.

mistakes.feedback_en: “Despite” can't be followed by a clause with “was”; say “despite the fan on full”.

mistakes.feedback_en: Here practise “despite” + noun phrase: “Despite the fan on full, …”.
